_comment: Fixture manifest for ci/gates/out_of_scope.py. The violating input is this
declaration: rebuild-plugboard declaring its own specifications
(openspec/changes/rebuild-plugboard/specs) out of its own scope, which D31
refuses as the containment case -- the byte-unchanged assertion cannot see
which change is editing, so the owner is refused every revision to its own
files. It also trips the 1/16 coverage shortfall, because this tree carries
one placeholder spec.md rather than rebuild-plugboard's sixteen.
